sql:
select
  t.name as tenant_name,
  count(*) as ticket_count,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (tk.first_response_at - tk.created_at))/60)::numeric) as avg_first_response_minutes,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (tk.resolved_at - tk.first_response_at))/60)::numeric) as avg_post_response_minutes,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at))/60)::numeric) as avg_resolution_minutes
from tickets tk
join tenants t on t.id = tk.tenant_id
where t.name in ('Marrowby & Vane', 'Studio Vrij', 'Cragsley Outfitters')
  and tk.created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01'
  and tk.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
  and tk.first_response_at is not null
  and tk.resolved_at is not null
group by t.name
order by avg_post_response_minutes desc, tenant_name
